scope: The 12 active legacy Admin product screens imported by the legacy product router. Status measures screen semantics, not whether a similarly named route exists.

statusDefinitions.candidate: The routed screen's primary operations have a new Admin screen and executable authenticated API contracts; production E2E is still required.
statusDefinitions.partial: A replacement screen exists, but one or more active legacy operations or relationships are absent or materially simplified.
statusDefinitions.missing: No new Admin screen currently implements the active legacy operation.

routes.title: 商品管理
routes.covered: List, search, create/edit entry, show/hide, delete, and isolated virtual-card inventory operations.
routes.remaining: Legacy batch operations, richer filters, verification actions, exports, relation editing, and complete SKU operations are not all available from this screen.

routes.title: 商品分类
routes.covered: Flat category list plus create, edit, visibility value, and guarded delete.
routes.remaining: The new screen does not expose the full legacy hierarchy, parent move, icon/image, product relation, and dedicated visibility workflows.

routes.title: 商品添加/编辑
routes.covered: Core scalar fields, category, unit, membership price, sorting, visibility, and server draft restore/save/delete.
routes.remaining: Guarantee selection, parameter-template application, specification-template application, SKU combination editing, gallery/rich-media selection, labels/brand and several legacy product types remain.

routes.title: 商品评论
routes.covered: Review list, image preview, visibility change, and delete.
routes.remaining: Product-scoped navigation, administrator replies, fictitious-review creation, pagination/filtering, and reply history are absent.

routes.title: 商品规格
routes.covered: Search, list, create, edit, delete, one-to-three SKU dimensions, up to fifty unique values per dimension, duplicate validation, and explicit SKU semantics.
routes.remaining: Applying the reusable structure inside the Admin product form and validating generated SKU rows belongs to the product-edit flow and remains open.

routes.title: 品牌管理
routes.covered: Brand list, name, logo URL, sort, visibility value, create, edit, and delete.
routes.remaining: The new UI does not expose full legacy category relationships, dedicated status operations, attachment selection, and in-product selection.

routes.title: 商品单位
routes.covered: Search, page, create, edit, duplicate prevention, product-reference protection, and product-form unit selection.
routes.remaining: Real production data CRUD and restricted-role E2E are still required.

routes.title: 商品标签
routes.covered: Simple product-label list, visual colors, create, edit, and delete; user labels are separately grouped on the same screen.
routes.remaining: Legacy label groups, show/status distinction, icon/badge settings, batch operations, and product-form assignment are not fully reproduced.

routes.title: 商品参数
routes.covered: Search, page, preview, create, edit, delete, sort, per-parameter status, and explicit separation from SKU specifications.
routes.remaining: Applying the template inside the Admin product form and validating historical template data in production remain open.

routes.title: 保障服务
routes.covered: Search, page, create, edit, enable/disable, sort, and reference-protected delete.
routes.remaining: Selecting guarantees in the product form and proving relation persistence remain open.

routes.title: 添加商品参数模板
routes.covered: The misleading legacy guarantee path is intentionally merged into the parameter-template dialog with template name, sort, and editable parameter rows.
routes.remaining: Production historical-data edit and save E2E remain open.

routes.title: 搜索热词
routes.covered: Platform-owner-scoped search, list, create, edit, visibility, soft delete, validated presentation fields, responsive preview, public storefront filtering, and transactional audit logs.
routes.remaining: Real production data CRUD, restricted-role E2E, and confirmation of historical color/icon compatibility remain open.
